countMethod: Read-only scan of locally stored papers. Count each primary-key ID once when metadata categories intersect the category set and published falls within the date interval.
limitations: Local category coverage is incomplete; this is not an arXiv-wide total.
Supplementary keyword and external-lead routes have not been fully merged.
Different arXiv IDs representing the same paper still need identity resolution.
Count indicates initial screening records, not full-review or admission decisions.
